description: Inspect or flip the session's dialog policy for window.alert/confirm/prompt. Dialogs never block the page: each is auto-answered (default dismiss) and logged into session_console at level "dialog". action "list" reports {policy, prompt_text, dialogs}; "accept" makes subsequent confirm() true and prompt() return prompt_text (or the call's default argument); "dismiss" restores the default.

action.description:
"list" reports the policy and dialog history; "accept"/"dismiss" set
the answer applied to subsequent window.confirm/prompt calls (alert
is always logged, never blocking).

prompt_text.description:
With action "accept": text window.prompt returns once accepted
(omitted keeps the current text).

name: session_dialog
